purpose: Retrospectively classify existing E06 evidence under E2.0 and independently recompute raw observations without changing the frozen E v1 result.

original_pre_execution_basis.relationship_to_execution: The versioned E06 PASS/FAIL/exhaustiveness basis predates the recorded execution start 2026-09-13T08:53:30.591Z.

calibration_disclosure: The E2.0 criteria author had access to the existing evidence. This calibration is therefore not an independent review; reliance on pre-execution locking comes from the earlier committed E06 basis above.

computations: Read artifact manifest: B build_count, B identity count, eligible nodes and node-specific source count.
Read activation receipt: selected/excluded nodes, expected release, source/tree/manifest/archive identities, S-B health and protected control process IDs.
Read rollback receipt: selected/excluded nodes, target release A, source/tree/manifest/archive identities, S-B health and protected control process IDs.
Read non-target diff: independently require total_change_count=0 and baseline/activation/rollback digests equal for S-A and S-C.
Read four-flow digest: independently require total_change_count=0 and history_recalculation_or_overwrite_count=0.
Verify all six file SHA-256 digests before accepting observations.

prelocked_thresholds: artifact B eligible node set = {s-a, s-b, s-c}
activation selected node set = {s-b}; excluded set = {s-a, s-c}; S-B release = B and health = ready
rollback selected node set = {s-b}; excluded set = {s-a, s-c}; S-B release = A and health = ready
protected S-A/S-C process IDs before and after activation/rollback are identical
non-target total change count = 0 and both control digests remain identical
four-flow total change count = 0 and history recalculation/overwrite count = 0
positive_cases: One shared candidate B is selectable by all three nodes.
Only S-B advances to B and later returns to A healthy.
negative_cases: Any node-specific source/build or second B identity.
Any S-A/S-C pointer, process, health, configuration or data change.
Any four-flow historical recalculation/overwrite or final S-B unhealthy state.

environment_classification_rules.DEV VERIFIED: All thresholds are met in local/disposable containers, simulations or developer-controlled isolated processes.
environment_classification_rules.STAGING VERIFIED: All thresholds are met in a stable, separately identified and configuration-managed staging environment with a documented production-difference list.
environment_classification_rules.PRODUCTION OBSERVED: The specified facts are directly observed in production under explicit authorization and a recorded time window; unexecuted negative cases remain gaps.
environment_classification_rules.INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED: A reviewer who did not design or execute the test independently validates hashes, re-runs the oracle and signs a relationship disclosure.

exhaustive_outcome_table.condition: All required files exist, hashes match, all thresholds are met, and environment identity is established.
exhaustive_outcome_table.environment_assurance: Use only the environment level proven by raw environment facts.

exhaustive_outcome_table.condition: Any threshold is contradicted by a raw observation.
exhaustive_outcome_table.environment_assurance: Use the environment level in which the contradiction was observed.

exhaustive_outcome_table.condition: Any required artifact, hash, raw field or environment fact is absent, inconsistent or unreadable.
exhaustive_outcome_table.environment_assurance: NOT ESTABLISHED unless the missing item cannot affect a separately scoped lower environment result.

exhaustive_outcome_table.condition: The claim is removed from scope by an approved applicability record.

forbidden_promotions: A directory or test label containing staging does not establish STAGING VERIFIED.
A DEV result does not establish production behavior.
A tool-generated PASS or this calibration does not establish INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED.
